gloss: to make sure; to remind emphatically

definitions.gloss: to make doubly sure; to stress a point to someone
definitions.explanation: To tell or ask someone again, firmly, so that there can be no mistake: reminding them of a promise, a deadline or an instruction, or confirming that they have understood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{念|ねん}を{押|お}した。
examples.english: I reminded him again and again.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れないで→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{念|ねん}を{押|お}された。
examples.english: I was told firmly, "Whatever you do, don't be late."

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{念|ねん}を{押|お}した。
examples.english: The president made a point of telling every employee to keep it secret.

notes:
The person reminded takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, and the point stressed is usually a quotation with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ or a clause with よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {念|ねん}を{押|お}す⟦ように{言|い}う→〜ように言う：29170_youniiu⟧: to say emphatically, to stress
- {念|ねん}を{押|お}して⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to double-check with someone
- {念押|ねんお}し: the noun, a firm reminder ({念押|ねんお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{釘|くぎ}→釘：03881_kugi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺|さ}す→刺す：02111_sasu⟧: to warn in advance — stronger, to stop someone doing something
- ⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to confirm, to check — the neutral verb
